# Keffini Creative Studio®

> Keffini Creative Studio is an independent creative agency and software studio based in Nairobi, Kenya. We build business solutions that drive real growth — blending brand identity, UI/UX design, full-stack software development, commercial photography, and performance digital marketing.

## Organization & Studio Facts
- **Studio Name**: Keffini Creative Studio®
- **Headquarters**: Aqua Plaza, Murang'a Road, Nairobi, Kenya
- **Public Contact Email**: Hello@keffini.com
- **Direct Phone**: +254 794 388 578
- **WhatsApp Channel**: +254 112 896 216 (https://wa.me/254112896216)
- **Primary Website**: https://keffini.com
- **Key Metrics**: $120K+ Client Revenue Generated, 95% Client Retention Rate, 100% Bespoke Solutions

## Core Services
1. **Brand Identity**: Logo design, typography systems, brand style guides, physical collateral, packaging design, and brand boards.
2. **UI/UX Design**: User journey mapping, interactive prototypes, design systems, mobile app design, and web interfaces.
3. **Software & Web Development**: Custom full-stack web applications, React / Vite SPAs, e-commerce stores, backend payment integrations (M-Pesa, Lipa Mdogo Mdogo), and Android/Play Store mobile applications.
4. **Social Media & Digital Marketing**: End-to-end content creation, monthly social media management, campaign art direction, paid acquisition, and growth strategy.
5. **Commercial Photography & Motion**: Studio and lifestyle brand photography, event coverage, video teasers, and print collateral.

## Flagship Case Studies
- **StarCall Phones** (2026): Branding, visual identity system, and full Android mobile app development for a Kenyan phone financing retailer (Lipa Mdogo Mdogo), live on Google Play Store (https://starphones.co.ke).
- **Battlezone Kenya (BZK)** (2026): Complete 3-month graphic rollout, teaser posters, graffiti identity refinement, merchandise apparel, and printed winner plaques for Kenya's premier street dance competition.
- **Foundations of Movement (F.O.M. Studio)** (2026): Full brand identity, mascot design, launch posters, oversized merchandise tees, pricing logbook, and ongoing social media management for Westlands street dance academy.
- **Ivory Horizons Tours** (2026): Luxury East African safari brand identity, stationery with QR codes, roll-up banners, branded safari vehicle livery, umbrellas, and social media feed management.
- **Squeaky Clean** (2026): Visual brand system, foam bubble logo, client thank-you cards, uniform apparel branding, and print promotional poster for Kitengela cleaning service.
- **Lunari Jewels** (2025): Everyday luxury jewelry visual identity and scroll-ready social media design system.
- **kazi Citas** (2025): Multi-service digital agency brand identity and online presence.
- **The Podium** (2026): Streetwear and dance culture passion project apparel design.
- **Casa V Ramoneda** (2025): Heritage Spanish tobacco store branding and packaging.
- **Habana Barber & Spa** (2025): Modern grooming brand identity, interior signage concepts, and spatial branding.
- **Wombman Africa** (2025): Feminine wellness brand identity, natural packaging design, and print materials.
- **Bills On Solar** (2025): Corporate and e-commerce web platform for Kenyan solar energy provider with product catalogue, cart, quote form, and AI assistant (developed by partner Harry / Harrison Ndeke).
- **Standout Growth** (2025): Personal brand coaching platform for Alice Ngatia with interactive quiz funnel, course sales, and newsletter integration.

## Rate Card & Engagement Model
- **Turnaround Times**: 3–6 weeks for brand identity projects; 4–10 weeks for websites and digital products.
- **Packages**:
  - Starter Plan: KES 40,000/month (2 platforms, 20 custom posts, graphic design & copy).
  - Growth Plan: KES 50,000/month (3 platforms, 30 custom posts, video reels & campaign ads).
  - Pro Plan: KES 80,000/month (4 platforms, daily posts, active community management, full brand strategy).
  - Custom Package: Bespoke scope for enterprise identity, mobile apps, or custom web portals.
- **Structured Pricing File**: https://keffini.com/pricing.md

## Frequent Questions & Answers
- **What is Keffini's typical turnaround time?** Most branding projects take 3–6 weeks; custom websites and digital applications typically take 4–10 weeks depending on scope.
- **Does Keffini use templates?** No. Every project is designed from scratch around the client's brand, audience, and commercial goals.
- **Can Keffini handle both design and development?** Yes. Keffini bridges brand strategy, UI/UX design, and full-stack software development (web, e-commerce, mobile applications, API/backend).
- **Where is Keffini based?** Keffini Creative Studio is based in Nairobi, Kenya (Aqua Plaza, Murang'a Road), and serves clients across East Africa and globally.
